candidates.bio: Deadly Alfano is a Toronto singer-songwriter who writes and performs original material.

Sunny St-Hillien Boisvert is a Montréal-based multidisciplinary artist whose path into music grew out of a professional dance career that began at a young age. He has appeared on Québec stages and television in productions including En direct de l’univers, Star Académie, La Voix and Révolution, where he reached the Season 4 grand finale and later returned for the all-star season. His performance work also includes musical theatre productions of Mary Poppins, Footloose and Mamma Mia, along with appearances alongside artists including Tory Lanez, Sarahmée, FouKi and CeeLo Green. After establishing himself as a dancer, choreographer and television personality, Sunny is putting a greater focus on recording. His earlier musical work includes the Dernière Danse project, while ‘Te Quiero’ begins a new chapter with GoodLife Entertainment Inc. Blending contemporary R&B and pop with French, English and Spanish elements, the single brings his music, dance and performance backgrounds together and is set for official release on September 25, 2026.
